_comment: The Archicad API items skipped in tools/api_coverage_rules.json because of Archicad itself (a bug, a crash or a missing capability), and how to retest each one when Graphisoft publishes a new DevKit. Every other skip is listed in otherSkips with its kind. Format and runbook: archicad-addon/DEVKIT_RETEST.md; check: python archicad-addon/Test/check_devkit_retest.py.

entries.problem: The ...ByKey setters of the pipe and duct branch preference tables ignore the key's branchAxisAngle and change the first row with the same main and branch axis reference ids.
howToRetest: In archicad-addon/Sources/MEPPreferenceTableRowCommands.cpp, SetPreferenceTableRowValues, branch of IsBranchRowTable under ServerMainVers_2900: temporarily replace the index setters (SetMainAxisDiameter, SetBranchAxisDiameter, SetBranchOffset, SetConnectionLength with index) by the ...ByKey setters with tableKey, and build the add-on with the new DevKit.

In Archicad, find an editable pipe branch preference table (GetMEPPreferenceTables with domain Piping, its branchTables) with two rows that have the same mainAxisReferenceId and branchAxisReferenceId but a different branchAxisAngle; if there is none, add the second row with AddMEPPreferenceTableRows (same reference ids, another branchAxisAngle, in the units GetMEPPreferenceTables returns).

Call SetMEPPreferenceTableRows on that table with the key of the SECOND row (mainAxisReferenceId, branchAxisReferenceId and its branchAxisAngle) and new values for mainAxisDiameter, branchAxisDiameter, branchOffset and connectionLength.
Read both rows back with GetMEPPreferenceTableRows. It passes when only the second row has the new values and the first row is unchanged; it fails when the first row changed.
Repeat on a duct branch table (domain Ventilation). Revert the temporary code change afterwards.
entries.unblocks: SetMEPPreferenceTableRows and AddMEPPreferenceTableRows could set branch rows by key instead of searching the row index, and these eight items count as used in the API coverage.

entries.problem: Checking a property expression terminates Archicad on an unknown function name, reports stored (valid) expressions as invalid and incomplete ones as valid.
howToRetest: Restore the CheckPropertyExpressions command removed in commit 8822f998 (added in a51466e5, PR #1146, part 1 of #1145): its class in archicad-addon/Sources/PropertyCommands.cpp/.hpp and its registration in AddOnMain.cpp, and build the add-on with the new DevKit.
Save the project first: the bug terminates Archicad.
Call CheckPropertyExpressions with an expression that uses an unknown function name (for example UNKNOWNFUNC(1)); it must return an error or invalid, not crash.
Call it with the expression string of an existing, working expression property (the 'expressions' of the property in GetAllProperties); it must report it valid.
Call it with an incomplete expression (for example 1 +); it must report it invalid.
It passes only when all three give the right answer without a crash.
entries.unblocks: A CheckPropertyExpressions command that validates an expression before CreatePropertyDefinitions or UpdatePropertyDefinitions stores it.

entries.problem: Bend::Modify does not compile against the Archicad 27 DevKit because Bend::Modifier does not derive from ACAPI::ModifierBase, which ExecuteUndoableScope requires; Archicad 28 has no Bend::Modifier and Archicad 29 replaced Bend with Elbow.
howToRetest: Only a new Archicad 27 DevKit release can change this; with a DevKit of a later Archicad version there is nothing to retest, record nothing.
With a new Archicad 27 DevKit: open archicad-addon/Build/DevKits/AC27/Support/Modules/MEPAPI/ACAPI/MEPBend.hpp and check whether Bend::Modifier now derives from ACAPI::ModifierBase.

If it does, build the add-on for Archicad 27 with a call such as bend.Modify ([&] (ACAPI::MEP::Bend::Modifier& modifier) { modifier.SetFactorRadius (1.5); }, "Modify bend") on a bend found through RoutingNode::GetBendIds; it passes when it compiles and the bend's radius factor changes in Archicad 27.
entries.unblocks: Changing the radius factor of an existing elbow (bend) on Archicad 27.
